feature.description: Full vertical slice for one new domain module: schema, Dexie table registration, repository + test, hook, component shell, barrel (issue #172 §7).

entity.description: One entity within an existing (or standalone) feature: Zod schema, repository + test, fixture factory, table registration. --remote emits a Supabase-backed repository and migration stub instead of Dexie's (issue #172 §12).

integration.description: Client/schema/adapter triple for one external integration. --kind=wallet emits the AuthProvider/WalletProvider stub pair instead (issue #172 §11).
